verdict.rationale: Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any candidate path, and the vendor's own manifest note states there is no OpenAPI document or documented REST API. The /.well-known/mcp.json discovery manifest only describes how to connect to the MCP endpoint (URL, transport, OAuth) and is not a downloadable spec of API operations, so it is adjacent rather than equivalent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
